target.statement: AUC of GDOF on the Audiology dataset with 5 labeled outliers is 0.871.

compute.basis: The method is a lightweight fuzzy-granule density algorithm with O(mn) complexity; the Audiology dataset has only 226 objects and 69 categorical attributes, so a single run takes seconds on a CPU, and the 10 repetitions plus setup fit well within 30 minutes.

title: Label-Informed Outlier Detection Based on Granule Density
